player_prompt.intro:
You are playing PegJump. Jump one peg over another into an empty hole, removing the jumped peg.
Goal: finish with exactly **one** peg left. Action format: e.g. '[4 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid syntax. Use [i->j]. Ukubomfya insoselo ya bufi, ukulemba amashiwi ayabipa.

outcome.win: Ici calengele ukuti kube fye icibumba cimo!
